args: const assert=require('node:assert/strict'); const handler=require('./api/wishes.js'); async function call(method,body,headers={}) { let code,payload; const response={setHeader(){},status(value){code=value;return this;},json(value){payload=value;}}; await handler({method,body,headers},response); return {code,payload}; } (async()=>{delete process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN; assert.equal((await call('GET')).code,401); assert.equal((await call('POST',{})).code,400); process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN='secret'; assert.equal((await call('GET',undefined,{authorization:'Bearer wrong'})).code,401); global.fetch=async(url,options)=>new Response(JSON.stringify([{name:'Friend',wish:'Happy birthday!',created_at:'2026-10-14T12:00:00Z'}]),{status:200}); const result=await call('GET',undefined,{authorization:'Bearer secret'}); assert.equal(result.code,200); assert.equal(result.payload.wishes[0].createdAt,'2026-10-14T12:00:00Z'); console.log('Wish API handler checks passed.'); })().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
